decisionMemo.businessProblem: A public consumer electronics company faces margin compression that threatens investor confidence and board stability. Revenue is flat ($1.2B, no growth) despite a growing smart home market (8% annual growth), indicating market share loss. Gross margin declined from 38% (FY2022) to 34% (FY2024), driven by product mix shift toward lower-margin devices and rising component costs. Operating expenses have not declined correspondingly—SG&A increased from 18% to 24% of revenue—resulting in operating margin declining from 10% (FY2023) to 7.1% (FY2024). The core challenge: Is the margin decline structural (product-market positioning requires margin recovery through cost reduction or pricing), competitive (losing share to scale competitors like Apple/Google/Amazon), or organizational (cost structure too high relative to revenue base)? The company must diagnose and communicate a margin recovery plan to investors within 6 months (next earnings guidance) to prevent activist intervention or board restructuring.
